Companion Animal Travel Desk: Arrival pickup, transfer, and booking controls
This page matters because clear records reduce delays, protect Willow’s welfare, and keep every handoff traceable across Aurelia Skyways. New staff should treat these controls as the dependable backbone of the desk’s service, just like the calm guidance travelers receive before departure.

Start by understanding arrival documentation. The entity arrival pickup is the required form for this step, with value FM-394. When a traveler sends materials to the desk, confirm the correct submission is present before you move the case forward to any next action. If you receive incomplete details, pause and ask the traveler to correct the record so the file remains consistent for downstream teams.

Next, manage role ownership for handoffs. The entity transfer is the staff oversight role, with value Records Curator. This means you route the file and any updates to the correct accountable role, and you avoid making judgment calls that belong to that oversight function. When Talia Chaudhary or Grace Rossi requests changes, document the request promptly so the oversight role can verify and approve.

Finally, respect timing. The entity booking sets the processing deadline, with value 84 hours. Monitor the timeline in the record and prioritize cases nearing that cutoff. If a file risks missing the deadline, elevate it immediately with complete, legible notes so decisions can be made without scrambling.

Remember: confirm the right form, route to the correct oversight role, and track the deadline in every case.
